title: SOC 2 evidence pack from CI logs
prompt: Generate a SOC 2 evidence pack from CI logs

steps.text: An auditor samples changes and asks three things for each: was it reviewed by someone other than the author, did the required checks pass before merge, and was the deploy traceable to that commit. CI logs already hold most of that. The pack has to be reproducible from raw logs, carry a hash manifest so nobody can quietly edit it, and redact anything that looks like a secret before it leaves the build system.

I'll build a reproducible SOC 2 evidence pack for CC8.1 (change management), CC7.1 (vulnerability monitoring) and CC6.1 (logical access), generated straight from CI logs with secrets redacted and a hash manifest. First, what CI keeps.

CC6.1 Logical access: production deploy requires an approver distinct from the author.
CC7.1 Vulnerability monitoring: SAST, dependency and secret scans gate every merge.
CC8.1 Change management: every production change has a reviewed PR and passing checks.

stages: [checkout, test, scan:sast, scan:deps, scan:secrets, deploy]
deploy:
  requires: [test, scan:sast, scan:deps, scan:secrets]
  approval: { distinct_from_author: true }

steps.context: Repo: sample-platform. Building tools/evidence/build_pack.ts that turns ci-logs/2026-Q4/*.jsonl plus PR metadata into an auditor-ready SOC 2 evidence pack (CC6.1, CC7.1, CC8.1). Output must be deterministic and redacted.

tasks.name: LogRedactor
tasks.task: Write a redaction pass for CI logs that removes tokens, keys, connection strings and email addresses before anything enters the evidence pack, with tests.
tasks.result:
# LogRedactor

tools/evidence/redact.ts: 11 patterns (bearer tokens, cloud keys, PEM blocks, connection strings, emails). Redaction is reported per file in the manifest. Tests: 14 pass, including a fuzz case with 500 synthetic secrets (0 leaks).

steps.text: Redact before parsing, not after; a secret in a malformed line must still be caught.
Redactor handles 11 secret shapes; fuzz test found 0 leaks.

tasks.name: ExceptionFinder
tasks.task: Scan the quarter's CI runs for control exceptions: merges without review, deploys without a distinct approver, and merges with failing or skipped scans.
tasks.result:
# ExceptionFinder

412 runs checked. 1 exception: run-18301 deployed with approver equal to author (hotfix during incident INC-0921). Linked to the incident record and the post-incident review, which counts as a documented exception.

steps.text: One documented exception (emergency hotfix with a post-incident review).

steps.text:
Evidence pack ready for Q4:

| Control | Population | Passing | Exceptions |
|---|---|---|---|
| CC8.1 change management | 388 changes | 388 | 0 |
| CC7.1 vulnerability scans | 412 runs | 412 | 0 |
| CC6.1 deploy approvals | 205 deploys | 204 | 1 (INC-0921, documented) |

The pack is deterministic (rebuild gives identical hashes), redacted before generation (23 values removed, 0 secrets after a re-scan), and every file is listed in a SHA-256 manifest. Rebuild any time with `bun run evidence:pack`.
